typeDescriptions.SIMPLE: Simple arithmetic calculation based on input arguments.
typeDescriptions.SCRIPT: Calculation over defined arguments using a TBEL script.
typeDescriptions.RELATED_ENTITIES_AGGREGATION: Aggregation of latest data from related entities.
typeDescriptions.PROPAGATION: Propagation of data to parent or child entities based on relation direction and type.
typeDescriptions.GEOFENCING: Evaluation of entity GPS position and transitions against configured geofencing zone groups.
typeDescriptions.ENTITY_AGGREGATION: Aggregation of historical data from a current entity.

messages.argumentsHint: Use argument names in expressions. Select the current entity, its owner, or a specific entity as the source.
messages.currentArgumentsHint: This mode uses arguments from the current entity. Related entity aggregation requires a default value for each argument.
messages.expressionHint: Default expression demonstrates how to transform a temperature from Fahrenheit to Celsius.
messages.scriptHint: TBEL script that defines the calculation logic and output values.
messages.propagationDataHint: Defines the data to be propagated from the arguments configured below. 'Arguments only' uses the retrieved data directly, while 'Expression result' calculates a new value from that data.
messages.propagationHint: Defines a direct, single-level path to a related entity based on the selected direction and relation type. Only relations between device, asset, customer, and tenant entities are supported. Maximum entities resolved by relation path is {max}.
messages.relatedHint: Aggregate data from entities linked by this relation.
messages.zonesHint: Perimeter coordinates are stored in server attributes of the source entity.
messages.metricsHint: Metric names become output keys. Define input arguments in the arguments section first.

intervalHelp.offsetEnabled: Defines how much to shift the start of each aggregation period (e.g., +10 minutes - 00:10, 01:10).
intervalHelp.watermarkEnabled: Defines how long to wait for delayed telemetry after the interval ends. If such telemetry arrives, the result for that interval will be recalculated.
intervalHelp.intermediate: Calculates metrics during the current interval to produce an intermediate result. Updates occur no more often than once every {time}.

messages.intervalHint: Windows follow the selected time zone. A watermark allows time for late data to arrive.
messages.strategyHint: Controls whether the result is processed immediately or sent to a rule chain for additional processing.
messages.inputFunctionHint: Use argument names in a TBEL function and return a numeric value to aggregate.
messages.filterHint: Use argument names in a TBEL function. Return true to include the data in aggregation.
messages.selectEntityBeforeArguments: Select an entity in the General section before configuring arguments.
messages.copyArgumentFailed: Copy failed. Please copy the argument name manually.
messages.simpleArgumentsHint: Arithmetic expression that defines how the calculated value is computed.
messages.scriptArgumentsHint: Defines the input arguments available to the script.
messages.expressionTitleHint: Arithmetic expression that defines how the calculated value is computed.

outputHelp.useLatestTs: If enabled, the calculated value will be persisted using the most recent timestamp from the arguments telemetry, instead of the server time.
outputHelp.customTtl: Defines the retention period for time series data. If disabled, the Tenant Profile TTL is used.
outputHelp.saveTimeSeries: Saves time series data to the ts_kv table in the database.
outputHelp.saveLatest: Updates time series data in the ts_kv_latest table in the database if the new value is more recent.
outputHelp.saveAttribute: Saves attribute data to the database.
outputHelp.sendAttributesUpdatedNotification: Sends an Attributes Updated event to the default rule chain.
outputHelp.sendWsUpdateATTRIBUTES: Notifies WebSocket subscriptions about updates to the attribute data.
outputHelp.sendWsUpdateTIME_SERIES: Notifies WebSocket subscriptions about updates to the time series data.
outputHelp.processCfsATTRIBUTES: Notifies calculated fields about updates to the attribute data.
outputHelp.processCfsTIME_SERIES: Notifies calculated fields about updates to the time series data.
outputHelp.updateAttributesOnlyOnValueChangetrue: Updates attribute only when the value changes. If the value is unchanged, timestamps are not updated and notifications are not sent.
outputHelp.updateAttributesOnlyOnValueChangefalse: Updates attribute on every incoming message, regardless of whether the value has changed. This increases API usage and reduces performance.

messages.configurationHint: Use the ThingsBoard JSON configuration format, including the selected type, arguments, expression and output settings. You can also import an existing calculated field.

validation.type: Select a supported calculated field type.
validation.name: Use a letter or underscore followed by letters, digits or underscores, up to 255 characters. Reserved names are not allowed.
validation.relationPath: Add at least one relation level.
validation.maxItems: A maximum of {count} items is allowed.
validation.arguments: At least one argument is required.
validation.currentSource: Arguments must use the current entity in this mode.
validation.latestOnly: Time series aggregation only supports latest telemetry.
validation.rolling: Rolling time series is not supported in this mode.
validation.currentArgument: Propagation requires an argument from the current entity.
validation.expressionLength: Simple expressions must not exceed 255 characters.
validation.zones: At least one zone group must be configured.
validation.metrics: At least one metric must be configured.
validation.metricType: Time series aggregation requires argument inputs and does not support unique counts.
validation.timezone: Enter a valid time zone, such as Asia/Shanghai or UTC.
validation.intermediate: The aggregation interval must exceed the system intermediate result interval.
validation.titleLength: Title should be less than 256 characters.
validation.configuration: Enter a valid JSON object with a type matching the selected calculation type
validation.import: Invalid calculated field configuration or unsupported type

aggregation.offsetExampleContinued: Your aggregation interval will be: {interval} and so on.
aggregation.intervalMultiple: Aggregate interval value must be a divisor or multiple of 1 day.
aggregation.argumentsHint: Data will be fetched from current entity.
aggregation.argumentsHelp: Defines the input arguments used for aggregation.
aggregation.intervalHelp: Defines how often aggregation is performed. Example: every 1 hour aggregates data at 00:00, 01:00, 02:00, etc. Aggregation results are stored with the timestamp corresponding to the start of the aggregation interval.
aggregation.watermarkHelp: How long to wait for delayed data after the interval ends.
aggregation.relatedPathHelp: Defines a single-level aggregation path via direct relations with parent or child entities, based on direction and relation type. Only relations between device, asset, customer, and tenant entities are supported. Maximum entities resolved by relation path is {max}.
aggregation.relatedArgumentsHelp: Defines the input arguments used for filtering and aggregation.
aggregation.relatedArgumentsHint: Data will be fetched from related entities configured in aggregation path.
aggregation.metricsHelp: Defines metrics aggregated based on configured arguments.
aggregation.entityMetricsHelp: Defines metrics aggregated based on configured arguments over the specified time intervals.
aggregation.filterHelp: Enables filtering of entities during aggregation. The filter function must return a boolean value and can use all configured arguments.
aggregation.inputHelp: Defines how the value for aggregation is obtained.

geofencing.coordinatesHelp: Specify the time series keys that provide entity GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude).
geofencing.zonesHelp: Define one or more geofencing zones groups to check (e.g. 'allowedZones', 'restrictedZones'). Each group must have a unique name, which is used as a prefix for calculated field output telemetry keys.
geofencing.refreshHelp: Defines how often zone groups configured via related entities are refreshed.
geofencing.perimeterHelp: Set the attribute key that contains the geofencing zone perimeter definition. The perimeter is always taken from server-side attributes of the zone entity.
geofencing.reportHelp: Presence status reports whether the entity is currently INSIDE or OUTSIDE the zone group. Transition events report when the entity ENTERED or LEFT the zone group.
geofencing.createRelationsHelp: Automatically create and maintain relations between the entity and the zones it is currently inside. Relations are removed when the entity leaves a zone and created when it enters a new one.
geofencing.maxZones: Maximum number of geofencing zones reached.
